Every module of the Czech and Slovak localization has its own guide. This page is the way in: it shows the first steps, then lists the guides by topic.

First steps

  1. Install the package for your country. Czech Accounting Localization or Slovak Accounting Localization installs the statutory core in one step: VAT return, control statement, EC sales list, the invoice layout and partner balances. The optional parts are switches in Accounting → Configuration → Settings, block Czech / Slovak Localization.
  2. Fill in the company. IČO, DIČ (and IČ DPH in Slovakia), the tax office and the legal form are on the company form; the filings take them from there. See the shared core.
  3. Let the registers fill in your partners. Type a company name or IČO on a contact and pick the match: Partner Autocomplete.
  4. Issue the first invoice. Variable symbol, payment QR code and the statutory wording are added for you. See Payment Symbols and the invoice guides.
  5. File the first VAT period. Open the VAT return or the control statement for the period, check it, export the XML, and file it — or send it directly where the module can do that. See Statutory Submissions.

Finding a guide

  • In Odoo, Accounting → Configuration → Guides opens this page with the modules of your server, marked installed or not.
  • Each module's guide is also its description in the Apps screen.
  • Guides of Slovak modules are in English and Slovak, of Czech modules in English and Czech, and of shared modules in all three languages.
